entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for my VeloBand.
Certainly, I can assist you with that. Can I get your full name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Yes, it's Alex Chen, a-l-e-x.chen@email.com. Can you just process the return?
Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your account now. To make sure I'm processing this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's a preference. Honestly, it's just **hard to use** and the whole interface is **confusing**. I read the **user manual** and I still can't get it to do what I want easily. I just **expected more** from it.
I understand, and I'm sorry to hear it wasn't a good fit for you. Let me just check your purchase details... Okay, I see the delivery date was 12 days ago.
Right. So can I return it?
Yes, absolutely. You're well within our 90-day return policy. I've just initiated that return for you in our system.

I've sent a pre-paid shipping label to your email, alex.chen@email.com. Simply pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any shipping center. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
